title: Research: bounded target accumulation saves additional complex primitives (no new kappa)
head: fd38a824adb3a5c60c101a86c950a6d590454adf
body:
I added a local compiler for bounded target accumulation on the four pinned CK/JP8 complex programs. It saves another 1,114 real-component primitives per CK orientation and 4,086 per JP8 orientation beyond PR696, while preserving the exact input/output map, source, private clearing and original per-register magnitude bounds.

This is a finite local circuit improvement, not a new kappa or a practical runtime claim. Only `research/complex-coefficient-accumulation/` is added; the selected emitter, frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Reproduce with Python 3.11+ and no dependencies:

    python3 -B research/complex-coefficient-accumulation/lower.py

Verified locally on macOS:

    PASS_COMPLEX_COEFFICIENT_ACCUMULATION programs=4 columns=716 extra_savings=1114,1114,4086,4086 controls=10

The check covers all 686 consumed coefficients, exact endpoints, cleanup, source pins, unchanged paid histograms and ten negative controls. Whitespace checks passed. Cold provider regeneration, full repository suites, Linux CI and Lean were not run; all inherited assumptions remain.

The README contains the substitution proof, pinned comparison and full provenance. Thanks to Sagar Thakrar (PR696), icekylinx, Jeremy Kothe, Chafik Boukhalfa, DreamingOfClouds and eumemic for the prior work. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human or delegated-agent review is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
